triggerReason: The public taxonomy treated humans as a strange fourth kind and the dashboard hid durable resource flows behind static-looking projections.
action: Changed the domain and PostgreSQL taxonomy to human, ai and robot; added a checksum-compatible migration and v1 API adapter; introduced deterministic inter-community resource balancing, resource-transfer events and a v2 Observatory contract; redesigned the front door around a city information layer with production, consumption, transfer, inventory and pressure ledgers.
outcome: Release implementation edc426e passed 245 tests including 16 real PostgreSQL/independent-restore checks, 25 Playwright/axe scenarios, zero lint warnings, zero audit vulnerabilities, exact 365-Turn replay with conserved resource transfers, the v2 closure gate and a 10,000-tick stress run. Annotated Tag v4.3.0 at bd285f9 was deployed to nexus7.carrick7.com; migration 0011, the 200 human / 36 AI / 24 robot taxonomy, anonymous read-only boundary, Turn 12 with 24 current resource ledgers and 16 transfer lanes, desktop/mobile/Chinese Chromium, zero live WCAG A/AA violations and checksum backups were verified.
